verdict.rationale: Virtual Mail (formerly Earth Class Mail) publishes a public REST API with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec and an official MCP server. Through these you can take real mailbox actions such as finding mail, scanning, shredding, tagging and moving items across every mailbox the user can access. However, no document claims API/UI parity, and UI features like check deposit, forwarding, multi-user access management and address selection are not shown as API-accessible. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of check deposit, forwarding, account and user management, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The OpenAPI 3.1 specification is available as a YAML file for import into tools like Postman, Swagger UI, or code generators.
take real actions on your behalf: scan or shred a piece of mail, apply tags or move it to a different folder
Your API key is tied to your user account, so it can reach every mailbox you have access to.
